post.summary: Admit a run of a repository-owned claw agent (work.claw.admit required)
post.description: Runs the agent cataloged at `.lcars/agents/{name}` of `{owner}/{repo}`. The round pins the enabled definition and the message. `sourceKey` names one Work item per caller: the same message (and `requestId`) returns its existing round, and a new one supersedes a queued round. Without `sourceKey` every call admits a new item. The report is the settled run message.

post.summary: Subscribe a live session on the calling host, or a dispatched run's Work, to an event key
post.description: With events.deliver: accepted only when the session telemetry reports the calling host and the session has not ended. With a run token and runId: the subscription targets the run’s own native Work (a workId naming any other Work is refused), and a matching event starts a resume run of that Work with the event notice as its input. Sources without an available producer are refused. Idempotent: the same target, key, kinds and until return the existing subscription.

post.summary: Report that a session on the calling host went idle or ended
post.description: Requires events.deliver. An idle report is accepted only for a session the telemetry reports live on the calling host; an ended report for any CLI session the telemetry reports from that host, live or not. Routes an lcars:session:<id> event whose id is derived from the session, kind and occurredAt, so a repeated report is not delivered twice.
